programme.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
programme.desc: Three World War II veterans return home to small-town America to discover that they and their families have been irreparably changed.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: It's the film that launched a genre and an iconic screen pairing as Frankie Avalon and Annette Funicello team for the first time for sand, surf and fun as an anthropologist (Robert Cummings) studies the wild dating habits of Malibu teenagers!

programme.title: Muscle Beach Party
programme.desc: Frankie Avalon and Annette Funicello and the gang are back together in the 2nd of American International's Beach Party films and this time the beach is overrun by muscle men and their obnoxious trainer.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: It's the film that launched a genre and an iconic screen pairing as Frankie Avalon and Annette Funicello team for the first time for sand, surf and fun as an anthropologist (Robert Cummings) studies the wild dating habits of Malibu teenagers!

programme.title: Muscle Beach Party
programme.desc: Frankie Avalon and Annette Funicello and the gang are back together in the 2nd of American International's Beach Party films and this time the beach is overrun by muscle men and their obnoxious trainer.

programme.title: Bikini Beach
programme.desc: There are big waves crashing at Bikini Beach! The beach is close to becoming a retirement village. And a British pop star comes between Dee Dee (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon). Will it all be resolved by the end of summer vacation?

programme.title: Tears of the Sun
programme.desc: After a West African president's family is assassinated and civil unrest is rampant, a top-secret team is deployed to the far reaches of the jungle to rescue a U.S. doctor who is acting as a missionary.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Stephen King's Sometimes They Come Back
programme.desc: A high school teacher (Tim Matheson) faces the demon ghosts of a gang of former students. Brooke Adams, Robert Hy Gorman, Robert Rusler, Nicholas Sadler, and William Sanderson also star. Based on a short story by Stephen King.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end. Because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Pet Sematary Two
programme.desc: Antagonized by the neighbourhood kids, Jeff befriends outsider, Drew Gilbert, who lives in fear of his cruel stepfather Gus. After Gus shoots Drew's beloved dog, the boys bury the body in a place rumoured to have powers of resurrection.

programme.title: Shaft (2000)
programme.desc: Who delivers ten times out of ten? Samuel L. Jackson is SHAFT, the man and the movie. John Singleton ("Boys 'n' the Hood") directs this gritty, action-packed thriller.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: A Force of One
programme.desc: In this thrill-a-minute film, action superstar Chuck Norris stars as a martial arts champion enlisted to help track down a serial killer...and the man responsible for the murder of his adoptive son. Jennifer O'Neill and Clu Gulager also star.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: An Eye For An Eye (1981)
programme.desc: A SFPD undercover narcotics cop aims to avenge his partner's death and destroy a drug-smuggling ring operated by the Chinese Triads.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Adventureland
programme.desc: From the director of SUPERBAD comes a coming-of-age comedy of big dreams, hysterical consequences, and young love, set in a run-down amusement park.

programme.title: Benny & Joon
programme.desc: Johnny Depp and Mary Stuart Masterson star in this quirky romantic Drama about two misfits who Comedye together as a result of an unusual poker game. Aidan Quinn and Julianne Moore co-star.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: She's Having a Baby
programme.desc: Last year at this time, Jake and Kristi were two crazy single kids in love. Now they're two crazy married adults in transition.

programme.title: Limitless
programme.desc: A mysterious pill that enables the user to access 100% of his brain's abilities transforms a struggling writer into a financial wizard, but it also puts him in a new world with many dangers.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: This one-of-a-kind musical biopic embarks on the spectacular journey of Elton John in his rise to fame. With incredible performances of Elton's most beloved songs, discover how a small-town boy became one of the most iconic figures in rock & roll.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose off-hand arrogance triggers a tragedy which ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

programme.title: Outlaw Justice
programme.desc: Starring Kris Kristofferson and Willie Nelson. Two aging gunfighters re-form their old gang to avenge the murder of one of the former members.

programme.title: The Claim (2017)
programme.desc: THE CLAIM is an epic story of love, passion and redemption set against the winter landscape of the Sierra Nevada Mountains and the making of California. Dillon is a pioneer who defied the harsh winter in search of rumored gold.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Academy Award-winner Charlize Theron stars as Aeon Flux, the underground operative fighting totalitarian rule in 25th-century Earth's last living city.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When NY City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Spotlight
programme.desc: This critically acclaimed film chronicles the true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered a decades-long cover-up of child abuse within the local Catholic Archdiocese.

programme.title: Hollywood Homicide
programme.desc: A pair of detectives investigate a murder while pursuing their other full-time professions. Welcome to Hollywood Homicide - the only place where you can come to work hungry, horny, thirsty, and broke, and resolve all four by the end of the watch.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers
programme.desc: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of a old church, Trish and her brother Darry watch their routine road trip home turn into a heart stopping race for their lives. They are now the chosen prey of a force that relentlessly pursues them.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: The Creeper terrorizes a group of varsity basketball players, cheerleaders and coaches who are stranded on a highway after their bus breaks down. Fighting their own fears and prejudices the group of athletes are forced to come together to stay alive.

programme.title: The Haunting in Connecticut 2: Ghosts of Georgia
programme.desc: When a family moves from the city to a centuries-old house in rural Georgia, they are terrorized by malicious spirits seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Reading
programme.desc: After a deadly home invasion, Emma (Mo'Nique Hicks) copes by writing a book, but when a young psychic and her team perform a reading in her home, a new terror is unleashed.

programme.title: The Amityville Horror (2005)
programme.desc: Based on the original movie, this modern remake tells the true story about a large house on the coast of Long Island where a newlywed couple and their three children move into, unaware that a murder took place in the house several years back.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: A remake of George Mihalka's 1981 classic slasher film, MY BLOODY VALENTINE takes place ten years after a devastating coal mining accident when a string of gruesome murders plagues a town.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Breathless
programme.desc: A fugitive (Richard Gere) heads to L.A. to track down Monica, a beautiful French woman studying at UCLA. Drawn in by the magnetism of Jesse's dark world, Monica can't help but fall for him and soon finds herself swept up in his run from the law.

programme.title: American Gigolo (1980)
programme.desc: Julian Kay has it all: the Mercedes, the clothes, access to Beverly Hills' swankiest establishments, and a stable of rich, female clients. But it all falls apart after he does a favor for his former pimp and the trick turns up dead a short while later.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father, in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The End of the Tour
programme.desc: A funny and touching exploration of fame, success, and friendship as we follow journalist David Lipsky (Jesse Eisenberg) during five days he spent on the road interviewing renowned and reclusive novelist David Foster Wallace (Jason Segel).

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie & his best friend Mont try to reclaim the home built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship & sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
programme.desc: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero (Michelle Yeoh) must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse as the fate of everything hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Warriors of Virtue
programme.desc: An action-adventure about a young boy who stumbles into a strange world and befriends five Kung Fu kangaroos who embody the virtues of benevolence, righteousness, integrity, wisdom and loyalty.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: Small Soldiers
programme.desc: Joe Dante directed this satirical action-comedy about talking tech toys accidentally juiced-up with military microchips.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose a local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: The Harder They Come
programme.desc: Reggae legend Jimmy Cliff stars as Ivan Martin, an aspiring singer hoping to make a name for himself. Robbed of his money and possessions, he finds work with a self-righteous preacher

programme.title: The 6th Day
programme.desc: In the very near future, cattle, fish, and even the family pet can be cloned. But cloning humans is illegal - that is, until family man Adam Gibson comes home from work one day to find a clone has replaced him.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: A wrongly-convicted man must try to survive a public execution gauntlet staged as a TV game show.

programme.title: XXX
programme.desc: Xander Cage is a notorious underground thrill-seeker deemed untouchable by the law. But when NSA Agent Gibbsons convinces Cage to infiltrate a ruthless Russian crime ring, this new breed of secret agent takes down the enemies of justice with a vengeance.

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: The true story of the undersized Depression-era racehorse whose victories lifted not only the spirits of the team behind it but also those of the nation as well.

programme.title: RV (2006)
programme.desc: A forced family vacation in a recreational vehicle rapidly turns into a disaster.

programme.title: Big Fish
programme.desc: Throughout his life, Edward Bloom (Ewan McGregor) has always been a man of big appetites, enormous passions and tall tales.

programme.title: Mortal
programme.desc: A psychologist tries to help a mysterious man who has the power to make people and objects burn by touching them.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: The Cimmerian warrior slashes his way across Hyboria on a mission that begins as a personal vendetta but turns into an epic battle against a supernatural evil.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: The fate of the human race hangs in the balance when the Witch Queen rises from the dead, seeking revenge against Kaulder, the immortal warrior who slayed her centuries ago.

programme.title: Three Kings
programme.desc: At the end of the Gulf War, a small group of American soldiers plots to steal a cache of gold near their Iraqi desert base. The men embark on a journey that forces them to confront their fears and flaws, while altering their lives forever.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: Pain & Gain
programme.desc: When an ambitious group of personal trainers go after the American Dream, they get caught up in a criminal enterprise that goes horribly wrong. Now, living large will take everything they've got in this unbelievable and outrageous true story.

programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

programme.title: Save The Last Dance
programme.desc: Sara is a small-town girl who dreams to become a world-class ballerina. But when her mother suddenly dies, she must abandon her plans and join her estranged father on Chicago's South Side.

programme.title: On the Come Up
programme.desc: The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Carter Oosterhouse travels to Raleigh, NC; Corpus Christi, TX; North Ridgeville, OH; & Sinking Spring, PA to judge which family has the most impressive Christmas display. The families up to win $50,000 are Moore’s, Mazoch’s, Micklos’, and Simpson’s.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Taniya Nayak travels to Alexandria, LA; Maple Valley, WA; Boulder City, NV; & Manchester, TN to judge whose house has the most impressive Christmas display. The families up to win $50,000 are The Monkhouse’s, Pahl’s, Ryan-Musgrave’s, and Winton’s.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Featured displays include a wireless light show, an interactive gingerbread house, fun figurines and giant lollipops, and a large property with 78 wrapped trees..

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Featured displays include a seven-acre drive-through property, a blue-lighted design, a 40-foot wall of lights and suspended inflatables, and a concert of lights with a five-piece band.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: The first neighbors versus neighbors episode; featured attractions include a synchronized light show, an 80-foot tree, a Santa tracker, a patriotic display.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Featured attractions include a massive mountainside display, a sloping yard with a 46-foot tree, and a holiday display that endured Hurricane Harvey.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic that has spread around the world.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Zola

programme.title: Blue Hawaii (1961)
programme.desc: His mother (Angela Lansbury) expects him to climb the corporate ladder. But Elvis would rather wear an aloha shirt than a white collar, so he goes to work as a tour guide. Lucky Elvis: his first customers are a car full of cuties.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: A businessman gets caught up in a criminal conspiracy during his daily commute home and works against the clock to stop a deadly attack to save the lives of his fellow passengers.

programme.title: Pet Sematary Two
programme.desc: Antagonized by the neighbourhood kids, Jeff befriends outsider, Drew Gilbert, who lives in fear of his cruel stepfather Gus. After Gus shoots Drew's beloved dog, the boys bury the body in a place rumoured to have powers of resurrection.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: A young couple is trapped in a remote town where a dangerous religious cult of children believes that everyone over age 18 must be killed.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Hustle & Flow
programme.desc: The tale of DJay, a pimp whose hustle selling sexy Nola leaves him wondering if this is it for him. Only when he trades contraband for a keyboard and bumps into his old schoolfriend Key does he see a way out by laying down some tracks.

programme.title: An Eye For An Eye (1981)
programme.desc: A SFPD undercover narcotics cop aims to avenge his partner's death and destroy a drug-smuggling ring operated by the Chinese Triads.

programme.title: Lone Wolf McQuade
programme.desc: A maverick Texas Ranger throws down his guns to indulge his talents in the martial arts when he meets his match in the leader of a gun-smuggling ring.

programme.title: Missing in Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Adventureland
programme.desc: From the director of SUPERBAD comes a coming-of-age comedy of big dreams, hysterical consequences, and young love, set in a run-down amusement park.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Real Genius
programme.desc: When a group of crazy college geniuses puts their heads together, almost anything can happen. Hold on for a freewheeling, uproarious look at just how much mischief a bunch of high-IQers can concoct. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: She's Having a Baby
programme.desc: Last year at this time, Jake and Kristi were two crazy single kids in love. Now they're two crazy married adults in transition.

programme.title: Soapdish
programme.desc: Sally Field leads an all-star cast in this side-splittingly funny look at a scandal-ridden TV soap opera.

programme.title: Flashdance
programme.desc: The visual and musical box-office smash Flashdance is the exhilarating story of Alex Owens (Jennifer Beals), a fiercely determined and beautiful 18-year-old woman, who works as a welder by day and a dancer at a local bar at night.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Vantage Point
programme.desc: During an historic counter-terrorism summit in Spain, the President of the United States is struck down by an assassin's bullet. Eight strangers have a perfect view of the kill, but what did they really see? Rated: PG-13

programme.title: The Net
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock, Dennis Miller and Jeremy Northam star in this hit thriller about a computer expert whose life is "erased" by a computer conspiracy. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose off-hand arrogance triggers a tragedy which ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: The Claim (2017)
programme.desc: THE CLAIM is an epic story of love, passion and redemption set against the winter landscape of the Sierra Nevada Mountains and the making of California. Dillon is a pioneer who defied the harsh winter in search of rumored gold.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Amnesiac gunman Jericho is rescued and befriended by a charismatic and itinerant cowboy/preacher named Joshua. Together they survive certain danger, while Jericho searches to find the answer to his lost identity.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: Paradise, Hawaiian Style
programme.desc: Elvis takes to the skies over the island paradise of Kauai. He’s a partner in a helicopter charter service. Romance, naturally, is in the air for the King…but his business may be grounded.

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: The king of rock 'n' roll, Elvis Presley, is as a lonely million-heir who gives up his fortune and trades identities with a water ski instructor to learn about life from the bottom up in this musical romp! Bill Bixby and Shelley Fabares also star.

programme.title: Frankie and Johnny
programme.desc: Join Elvis Presley and Donna Douglas for a riverboat ride of rollicking musical entertainment in this charming and sassy comic hit about a gambler and his lady love.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: A tight-knit team of skilled combat vets turned mercenaries, set out to save the innocent and punish the guilty in this blistering action-packed thriller.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Barney and his mercenaries race to stop five tons of weapons-grade plutonium from falling into the wrong hands in this all-star, action-packed sequel.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone stars in this explosive thrill-ride. When The Expendables face an old rival, it's a clash of old-school versus high-tech in the most personal battle yet.

programme.title: Christine (1983)
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Stephen King, CHRISTINE tells the story of a 1957 Plymouth that takes on human characteristics.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end. Because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Pet Sematary Two
programme.desc: Antagonized by the neighbourhood kids, Jeff befriends outsider, Drew Gilbert, who lives in fear of his cruel stepfather Gus. After Gus shoots Drew's beloved dog, the boys bury the body in a place rumoured to have powers of resurrection.

programme.title: Drumline
programme.desc: A drummer helps his Atlanta College marching band defeat a rival in a Southern battle-of-the-bands.

programme.title: Do the Right Thing
programme.desc: Spike Lee wrote, produced, directed, and starred in this critically acclaimed comedy-drama, featuring Danny Aiello, chronicling the hottest day of the year in a diverse Brooklyn neighborhood.

programme.title: Hustle & Flow
programme.desc: The tale of DJay, a pimp whose hustle selling sexy Nola leaves him wondering if this is it for him. Only when he trades contraband for a keyboard and bumps into his old schoolfriend Key does he see a way out by laying down some tracks.

programme.title: Missing in Action 2: The Beginning
programme.desc: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: Code of Silence
programme.desc: When a stakeout marred by mob interference results in the death of an innocent bystander and a police cover-up, a Chicago detective is forced to adhere to his own personal code of ethics in an effort to rid the Windy City of its Warring crime factions.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Superstars Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman and Julia Roberts star in award-winning director Steve Spielberg's updating of PETER PAN.

programme.title: RV (2006)
programme.desc: A forced family vacation in a recreational vehicle rapidly turns into a disaster.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: About Last Night (1986)
programme.desc: Rob Lowe doesn't want to get serious. Demi Moore doesn't want to get used. Together, they're an unforgettable couple in the sexy, contemporary comedy, ABOUT LAST NIGHT. Rating: R

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: A Few Good Men
programme.desc: Tom Cruise stars as a brash Navy lawyer who's teamed with a gung-ho litigator (Demi Moore) in a politically explosive murder case, defending two Marines accused of killing a fellow soldier

programme.title: The People vs. Larry Flynt
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Milos Forman directs Woody Harrelson and Courtney Love in this acclaimed film about "Hustler" publisher Larry Flynt. Rating: R

programme.title: American Outlaws
programme.desc: When a Midwest town learns that a corrupt railroad baron has captured the deeds to their homesteads without their knowledge, young ranchers join forces to take back what is rightfully theirs.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman and Wes Studi as Geronimo, giving a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: The Ballad of Lefty Brown
programme.desc: A merciless cowboy sets out on a dangerous journey across the frontier, determined to do whatever it takes to avenge his partner's brutal murder.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When NY City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on the planet.

programme.title: Bone Tomahawk
programme.desc: When a group of cannibal savages kidnaps settlers from the small town of Bright Hope, an unlikely team of gunslingers, led by Sheriff Hunt (Kurt Russell), sets out to bring them home.

programme.title: Deliver Us from Evil (2014)
programme.desc: A NYPD officer (Eric Bana) and unconventional priest Mendoza (Edgar Ramírez) who join forces to investigate a series of disturbing & inexplicable crimes. Together, they must combat the possessions that are terrorizing their city before it's too late.

programme.title: The Haunting In Connecticut
programme.desc: After a family is forced to relocate for their son's health, they begin experiencing supernatural behavior in their new home, which turns out to be a former mortuary and séance parlor.

programme.title: The Haunting in Connecticut 2: Ghosts of Georgia
programme.desc: When a family moves from the city to a centuries-old house in rural Georgia, they are terrorized by malicious spirits seeking revenge.

programme.title: Heartburn
programme.desc: She's a magazine writer who gives up her career for love and family. He's a playboy newspaper columnist who can't quite give up his old tricks. And if that combination doesn't give a relationship Heartburn, nothing will!

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee
programme.desc: Michael J. Crocodile Dundee is a free-spirited Australian who hunts crocodiles with his bare hands, stares down giant water buffaloes, and drinks mere mortals under the table.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee II
programme.desc: Just as the eccentric Australian is starting to adjust to life in New York City, Dundee and his beautiful girlfriend (Linda Kozlowski) are targeted for death by a gang of ruthless drug dealers.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father, in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: A young programmer (Domhnall Gleeson) at an internet company is chosen by a reclusive CEO (Oscar Isaac) to evaluate the capabilities and consciousness of a beautiful and sophisticated robot (Alicia Vikander).

programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.

programme.title: Love Lies Bleeding
programme.desc: A bodybuilder headed through town to Vegas is thrust into the dangerous plot of a violent crime family when she falls into a steamy romance with her trainer (Kristen Stewart) in this heart-pounding thriller.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: The Peacemaker
programme.desc: When a train carrying atomic warheads crashes in the Soviet Union, nuclear specialist Dr. Kelly discovers the accident is really part of a plot to cover up the theft of the weapons.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: Lenny
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman magnificently captures the complexities and contradictions of the legendary comedian Lenny Bruce's mercurial character.

programme.title: Midnight Cowboy
programme.desc: This Academy Award-winning Best Picture stars Dustin Hoffman and Jon Voight in standout, Oscar-nominated performances as a con man and a Texas hustler trying to survive on the tough streets of New York. The legendary John Schlesinger directs.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: Moon
programme.desc: Sam Bell (Sam Rockwell) is nearing the completion of his 3-year-long contract with Lunar Industries, mining Earth's primary source of energy on the dark side of the moon.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Tropic Thunder
programme.desc: Ben Stiller, Jack Black and Robert Downey Jr. lead an ensemble cast in 'Tropic Thunder,' an action comedy about a group of self-absorbed actors who set out to make the most expensive war film.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: The Mist
programme.desc: Trapped townspeople (Thomas Jane, Marcia Gay Harden, Laurie Holden) face monsters inside and out after a supernatural fog engulfs their Maine community.

programme.title: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
programme.desc: On Halloween 1968, Stella and her two friends meet a mysterious drifter, Ramón, and uncover a sinister notebook of stories.

programme.title: The Cabin in the Woods
programme.desc: Two unseen scientists manipulate the gory goings-on at a backwoods cabin inhabited by a group of unsuspecting college friends (Kristen Connolly, Chris Hemsworth, Anna Hutchison).

programme.title: Three Kings
programme.desc: At the end of the Gulf War, a small group of American soldiers plots to steal a cache of gold near their Iraqi desert base. The men embark on a journey that forces them to confront their fears and flaws, while altering their lives forever.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: Pain & Gain
programme.desc: When an ambitious group of personal trainers go after the American Dream, they get caught up in a criminal enterprise that goes horribly wrong. Now, living large will take everything they've got in this unbelievable and outrageous true story.

programme.title: Barbershop
programme.desc: Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and a waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy.

programme.title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
programme.desc: The Barbershop is threatened by the arrival of a hip, well-financed chain barbershop that's about to open next door.

programme.title: Beauty Shop (2005)
programme.desc: Gina is a long way from the Barbershop - she's moved from Chicago to Atlanta and buys a rundown salon and inherits a motley group of stylists and a colorful clientele. It's a rocky road to fulfilling her dreams, but you can't keep a good woman down!

programme.desc: The tallest man-made mega tree; a whimsical Germany meets California display; a replica of the Golden Gate Bridge; a display using intricately designed Chinese lanterns; robots built from recycled materials.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

programme.title: On the Come Up

programme.title: The Delta Force

programme.title: About Last Night (1986)

programme.title: Flight 7500

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean se pone nervioso cuando aparece un “monstruo” en su pastel. Sin embargo, la buena noticia es que el monstruo resulta ser un pajarito inofensivo. La mala noticia es que se convierte en una enorme cigüeña y se hace cargo de su hogar.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Toneladas de ranas salen del cascarón en el baño de Mr. Bean. Su casera ha invitado al alcalde a tomar el té. Ahora tendrán la compañía de cientos de anfibios enojados.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean conoce a una anciana aristocrática cuando casi atropella a su perro. Está encantado de ser invitado a almorzar en su mansión grandiosa. Lo que no se da cuenta de que la dama y su siniestro mayordomo no son lo que parecen ...

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Después de ver un documental en la televisión, Bean decide decorar su habitación al estilo del Palacio de Buckingham. Mientras tanto, su casera, la Sra. Wicket, sufre ilusiones de grandeza y se corona a sí misma Reina de la calle.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Bean se encuentra a la carrera para cultivar un zucchini con su vecino de al lado. Y así, a medida que la competencia se pone difícil, las técnicas de jardinería de Bean se vuelven más ingeniosas, poco convencionales y desesperadas.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean se encuentra con un alma gemela. Un hombre que usa su misma camisa, chaqueta, pantalón y calzoncillos. Sin embargo, Bean cae a la Tierra de un golpe, cuando su novia, Irma Gobb, encuentra al hombre mucho más guapo que Bean.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: ¡Mr. Bean hace su propia película de terror y pone a la Sra. Wicket como la estrella! Mr. Bean no está impresionado con una película de terror que ve en el cine, y cree que puede hacerlo mucho mejor.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean tiene que cuidar el pez dorado de la señora Wicket, pero Scrapper el gato está dispuesto a "ayudar”. Cuando pierde a su amigo, emprende un viaje de pesadilla en la alcantarilla ¿Podrá Mr. Bean volver a meter al pez antes de que Wicket regrese?

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean gana boletos para un crucero, pero si pudiera quedarse. Una vez en el transatlántico, Bean lleva una vida de lujo, pero se queda varado en una isla desierta. Cuanto más hambriento se pone, más salvaje se vuelve y necesita encontrar una salida.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean espera ganar algunos premios en el parque de atracciones, pero no es fácil. Bean está decidido a ganar dinero en el Coconut Shy. Después de muchos intentos fallidos, revela una solución. El dueño del puesto se enoja y se produce una persecución.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: La electricidad de Mr. Bean se corta cuando la Sra. Wicket ve el costo de su factura de electricidad, por lo que construye una turbina eólica. Todo bien hasta que hay demasiado viento , que crea una oleada de electricidad y una gran conmoción para todos.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean intenta recuperar su tarjeta y "accidentalmente" termina dentro de una bóveda. Bean va al banco a sacar dinero, pero no recuerda su pin. Cuando el cajero automático se traga su tarjeta solo se hace una cosa: entrar en la máquina y recuperarla.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean tiene que lidiar con un huésped no deseado de la casa, pero la terca plaga se niega a irse.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: En un pueblo determinado, Shippo conoce a una chica llamada Satsuki. Ella cree que su hermano, que fue a la guerra, regresará. Ella le muestra a Shippo el tesoro que su hermano le dio, un fragmento de Joya Sagrada, pero es solo una flor hecha de piedra.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Los maridos están siendo atraídos fuera de su pueblo por un hermoso demonio. Sus esposas le piden a Miroku que derrote al demonio. Preocupado por él, Sango lo acompaña. Pero Sango está separado de él por una extraña niebla.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Sango regresa a la aldea de los asesinos para arreglar su Hiraikotsu, y Kagome regresa al pozo para que pueda regresar al día presente. En el camino, encuentra una Nimenka, una fruta que parece una cara.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Tokajin secuestra a Kagome de su jardín en miniatura. Inuyasha puede escapar del jardín en miniatura con la ayuda de Miroku y los demás y va a salvar a Kagome. Mientras se escapa, encuentra una flor con la cara de un viejo sabio en ella.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Sango regresa a la aldea de asesinos de demonios y repara su Hiraikotsu. Ella también deja que descansen las cenizas de su padre y de sus camaradas. Cuando ella está a punto de irse, es atacada.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Naraku llama a una sacerdotisa llamada Tsubaki. Hace cincuenta años, Tsubaki fue derrotada por Kikyo. Ella es una sacerdotisa oscura que vendió su alma a un demonio para mantener su juventud y ahora está detrás de la sangre de Kagome.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Kagome lucha desesperadamente contra la maldición que le impone Tsubaki, una sacerdotisa oscura. Mientras tanto, Kikyo aparece ante Tsubaki. Tsubaki se sorprende y corta su maldición.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: La maldición de Tsubaki roba la conciencia de Kagome. Kagome se olvida del Japón feudal en un mundo ilusorio.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Tsubaki visita la mansión onmyoji donde una vez entrenó. Ella planea abrir una puerta prohibida para entrenar a un ogro que estaba sellado en la pagoda con el poder de la Joya Shikon.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy se encuentran con una bonita oruga llamada Momo, pero él se metamorfosea en una polilla halcón de cabeza muerta y ataca la colmena y comienza a vaciar la miel. Maya tiene que convencer a Momo de que deje la colmena

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Si bien es el gran día de la cosecha de polen, Maya y Willy por error han puesto ha dormir toda la colmena. Ahora tienen que pedirles a todos sus amigos que les ayuden con la cosecha de algas, una flor que florece sólo un día al año.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Un grillo evita que todo el prado duerma. Maya y Willy lo buscarán. Chris, el grillo, sólo está tratando de invitar a Lila la señora de cricket para ir a la pelota, pero él le envía el mensaje equivocado!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Mientras juegan, Maya y Willy accidentalmente destruyen la casa de un pequeño gusano de frutas. Maya quiere ayudarlo a encontrar un nuevo lugar tranquilo

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya tiene dificultades para aprender el baile de las abejas, muy útil para moverse a las direcciones correctas. Flip tratará de ayudarla y gracias a sus lecciones, Maya podrá mostrar a la abeja trabajadora principal un nuevo campo de flores

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: A través de una combinación de circunstancias, Willy se convierte en el rey muy mimado de un pulgón perdido escuchado. Pero cuando los pulgones realmente necesitan a su "rey" para protegerlos, Willy necesitará la ayuda de Maya.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy cruzan el bosque para ver una flor muy rara, la flor de luna, pero quedan atrapados por la noche y se pierden. Por suerte, pueden contar con una luciérnaga para ayudar a encontrar el camino de regreso

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya ha mojado accidentalmente las alas de Beatrice. Ha perdido algo de su pólvora y ya no puede volar. Maya tiene que encontrar una solución para ayudarla, ya que la gran bola de mariposa se acerca rápidamente

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Harto del protocolo pesado, la Reina decide dejar la colmena por un momento para visitar el prado. Ella conoce a Maya que está encantada de hacer que la Reina descubra su universo. Pero sin la Reina, la colmena se acerca al caos

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Una mosca ha robado la pelota de Ben para usarla como nido para poner sus huevos. Por desgracia, es la pelota que Ben quería mostrar en la gran reunión de escarabajos! Maya y Willy deciden ayudar a Ben a hacer una nueva pelota

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Los primos de Flip llegan al prado. Cuando están todos juntos, extrañamente cambian su color y su comportamiento. Como Flip también está cambiando, Maya se da cuenta de que podría perder a su amigo. ¡Ella hará cualquier cosa para recuperarlo!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy han atrapado varroas, una especie de piojos de abeja. La colmena está infectada. Deciden pedir a las abejas silvestres del bosque consejos sobre cómo deshacerse de estos parásitos

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Mientras juegan, Maya y Willy rompen el caparazón de Shelby por error. Tienen que encontrar una manera de reparar la grieta antes de que se ponga peligroso para su amigo.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya quiere ayudar al Escarabajo de la señorita Rosie, una anciana que perdió su casa durante una tormenta. Ella quiere encontrar a su hermano que vive en un viejo árbol al otro lado del estanque.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: El Juez Beeswax está visitando la colmena. Es testigo de un accidente causado por Maya. Decide establecer una licencia de vuelo. Ahora las abejas tienen que permanecer en el suelo y no pueden hacer su trabajo correctamente

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya conoce a una linda peluca que es un verdadero artista y esculpe todo lo que ve. Pero su arte es malinterpretado por los otros que tienden a rechazarlo. Maya le ayudará a ser aceptado por la comunidad

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya juega con pequeñas chinches. Pronto se da cuenta de que están solas y trata de encontrar a su madre. Ella descubre que la madre está desesperada por darles de comer.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Sin saberlo, Willy se come el pastel de la Reina. Junto con Maya, tratarán de encontrar la receta y hacer un nuevo pastel antes de que todos en la colmena se den cuenta de que el pastel ha desaparecido

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya se encuentra con una colonia de polillas que cruzan el prado. Ella trata de ayudarles a encontrar la dirección correcta para su nido, ya que son muy peligrosos para los otros insectos. ¡Sus pelos están provocando erupciones a quien los toca!

programme.desc: Llega el momento de enfrentarse a Zabuza pero en esta ocasión tiene compañía: el ninja rastreador. Él y su compañero se fijan en las habilidades de Sasuke, y los dos se da cuenta del poder que oculta el ninja enmascarado. La batalla comienza.

programme.title: Naruto: El Número Uno Hiperactivo Ninja Cabeza Hueca Entra A Jugar

programme.title: Naruto: Visibilidad Cero: El Sharingan Desquebrajado

programme.title: Naruto: El Sello Roto

programme.title: Naruto: Pasado Blanco: Ambición Escondida

programme.title: Naruto: Las Armas Conocidas Como Shinobi

programme.title: Naruto: El Demonio De La Nieve
programme.desc: Naruto enfrenta a Zabuza. Aunque parece no tener emociones, Zabuza está desolado por la pérdida de Haku, la única persona del mundo en la que podía confiar. Naruto se da cuenta de que esta cruel realidad es el destino de los ninjas.

programme.title: Naruto: Un Nuevo Capítulo Comienza: El Examen Chunin

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Un robo a un banco entrelaza las vidas del director de la sucursal, un restaurador, una joven policía embarazada, un policía veterano, y una docena de personas. Vivirán varias horas en compañía de cuatro ladrones con perfiles muy diferentes.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Una joven policía, da suministros a los rehenes, uno de los cuatro ladrones está enfermo y necesita insulina. El Comisionado acepta darle una dosis a cambio de un rehén. En el sótano, dos cómplices perforan una pared que da acceso a la bóveda.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Alex accede a la bóveda, y a un botín de ocho millones de euros. Los rehenes siguen atados con sus ojos vendados. Los ladrones se preparan para evacuar el banco a través de los sótanos.

programme.title: El Asalto del Vuelo

programme.title: Austin Powers - Súper Agente

programme.title: Encuentro Explosivo
programme.desc: Cuando June conoce a un misterioso extraño, cree que ha encontrado al hombre de sus sueños pero descubre que es un súper espía fugitivo que la involucra en una emocionante persecución.

programme.title: Tooken

programme.title: Excluidos

programme.title: Alone

programme.title: La Invocación

programme.title: La doble vida con Velvet

programme.title: El Impostor
programme.desc: Julius invita a sus colegas a un viaje en velero en el barco de su familia aristocr�tica, pero algo sale mal. Julius no es quien parece ser.

programme.title: Runner, Runner
programme.desc: Richie cree que lo estafaron, va a Costa Rica para enfrentar a un magnate.

programme.title: Aceleración Máxima

programme.title: Una Loca Película de Vampiros

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Españoles en el Mundo
programme.desc: En Los Angeles estaremos con Pau Gasol,Anthony Hopkins o Huecco.Conoceremos mas sobre la ciudad y su industria del cine.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Tsubaki visita la mansión onmyoji donde una vez entrenó. Ella planea abrir una puerta prohibida para entrenar a un ogro que estaba sellado en la pagoda con el poder de la Joya Shikon.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Tsubaki es una sacerdotisa que fue considerada a la par con Kikyo. Estaba celosa de que la Shikon Jewel no le fuera confiada, por lo que se convirtió en una sacerdotisa oscura.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Una noche, alguien posee a Sango para atacar a Miroku. El grupo examina al demonio ciempiés que sospechaban que estaba detrás, pero están equivocados. Miroku es poseído a continuación y ataca a Sango. Shippo es acorralado por una pequeña sombra.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Hay una grieta en la barrera de Naraku. Pero es el comienzo del mes, y cuando cae la noche, Inuyasha pierde sus poderes demoníacos, y la búsqueda de Naraku se cancela.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Kagura se acerca a Sesshomaru y le dice que mate a Naraku, pero Sesshomaru se niega. Mientras Inuyasha y los demás buscan a Kagura, se dan cuenta de que Naraku es un medio demonio.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: A Shippo se le envía una carta desafiándolo a una batalla. El remitente de la carta es Soten Raijyu, y aún es solo un niño. Investigó a Inuyasha y los demás y determinó que eran demasiado fuertes, por lo que centra su atención en Shippo.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Un demonio nacido de un pedazo de carne que Naraku descartó se transforma en un hombre sin rostro y se roba el bello rostro de Muso, un monje viajero. El demonio se llama a sí mismo Muso y mata y saquea a lo largo de su camino a la aldea de Kaede.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Muso ataca a Kagome. Inuyasha lo destruye con su Cicatriz de Viento. Naraku, que estaba viendo el evento, le dice a Kagura que le diga a Inuyasha a dónde fue Muso. Después de que Inuyasha y los otros se van, Muso se regenera.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Muso se regenera incluso cuando fue golpeado con la Cicatriz del Viento. Miroku le dice a Inuyasha que Muso tiene un corazón en el área donde tiene una marca de araña. Pero Kagura interfiere, y las avispas del infierno quitan el fragmento de Muso.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya se encuentra con una colonia de polillas que cruzan el prado. Ella trata de ayudarles a encontrar la dirección correcta para su nido, ya que son muy peligrosos para los otros insectos. ¡Sus pelos están provocando erupciones a quien los toca!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya hace amistad con un abejorro. Cuando las avispas roban la miel de un mensajero especial, Syrphie ayuda a Maya a recuperarla, fingiendo ser unas avispas entre Stinger y sus amigos.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Shelby sueña con volar. Maya y Willy quieren ayudarlo a cumplir su sueño. Pero las cosas no salen según lo planeado

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Es el festival de primavera. Maya y Willy están emocionados, la colmena vecina ha decidido ofrecer a la colmena de pradera un tulipán lleno de polen. Pero el convoy es atacado por las avispas

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy descubren una flor que hace delicioso néctar. ¡Pero sólo queda uno en el prado! Maya decide polinizar la flor para crear nuevas flores

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Max está enamorado de una hermosa oruga. Ayudado por Maya, trata de convertirse en su amigo y pasar algún tiempo con ella. ¡Pero de repente, ella desaparece para convertirse en una mariposa!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Tekla está enferma, pero nadie se atreve a acercarse a ella. Maya siente lástima por ella y decide ayudarla. Ella le pregunta a la Reina si puede conseguir algún propóleo para curarla, pero la Reina se niega

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Para una fiesta, la Reina quiere volver a ver a un famoso cantante de abejas, que solía hacer equipo con el músico Flip. Maya decide encontrarlo, Pero la abeja ya no quiere cantar

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Max ya no puede dormir. Algo hace ruidos extraños en sus galerías. Maya Flip y Willy deciden salir para una gran exploración, y descubrirán un mundo subterráneo completamente nuevo!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Vesper está enamorada de Beatrice. Maya decide ayudarlo

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Cera de abejas decide que la colmena es demasiado pequeña para muchas abejas, algunos de ellos tienen que moverse y encontrar una nueva colmena, Willy es elegido para salir

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Lara pretende ser capaz de cambiar el clima. Cuando en realidad lee los signos en la naturaleza, Pronto se da cuenta de que esta habilidad es interesante, Pero Maya descubre su mentira

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y sus amigos encuentran un huevo. No saben de dónde viene, ni qué tipo de animal es. Maya decide encontrar su nido antes de que eclosione

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Ben conoce a Rudy, otro chico del escarabajo. Ambos se desafían mutuamente para conseguir el estand de trabajo más hermoso que han visto

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Nuestros insectos ven un eclipse por primera vez, es el pánico en la colmena. Maya que conoce muy bien la pradera ayudará a los otros insectos a organizarse

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: El campamento de hormigas es atacado por un hormiga león. Maya y Willy ayudarán a las hormigas a poner sus huevos a salvo en la cabaña secreta de Henri

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Primera parte de un doble episodio sobre el nacimiento de Maya., su descubrimiento de la vida de la colmena y su organización, su amistad con Willy y Flip. Pronto, Maya descubre la pradera y su libertad

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya se escapa de la colmena por la noche por primera vez. Vive una aventura con Willy y los salva de una rana y un búho. Luego decide vivir en el prado

programme.title: Naruto: Un Nuevo Capítulo Comienza: El Examen Chunin
programme.desc: Naruto y compañia regresan a la Aldea Escondida entre las Hojas después de su batalla en la Tierra de las Olas. Aunque cumplen las misiones, Naruto no está satisfecho. Pronto descubre que los extraños están apareciendo en el Leaf Village.

programme.title: Naruto: Identifíquense: Nuevos Y Poderosos Rivales
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura son de los elegidos para tomar el Examen Chunin, pero Iruka se opone a que participen. Son muy jóvenes y carecen de la experiencia y habilidades necesarias. Kakashi piensa que están listos para afrontar el desafío.

programme.title: Naruto: Reto Chunin: Rock Lee Versus Sasuke
programme.desc: Mientras se preparan para el examen, Rock Lee entra en escena. Lee quiere enfrentarse a Sasuke, quien guarda el poder del Clan Uchiha. Sasuke acepta el reto pero los ataques de su oponente son tan rápidos que lo único que puede hacer es defenderse.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡La Batalla Genin! Los Nueve Novatos Se Enfrentan
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura se inscriben al Examen Chunin, en el tres ninjas deben formar equipo y ninguno puede fallar. El trabajo en equipo es indispensable. Se quedan estupefactos al ver que hay muchos otros que persiguen el mismo sueño.

programme.title: Naruto: Enciendan Motores: Los Examenes Chunin Comienzan
programme.desc: Naruto y su equipo comienzan la prueba, un examen escrito. El examinador es un jonin llamado Ibiki. Aprobar el examen depende de los tres. Sasuke y Sakura están preocupados de que si Naruto responde mal, también fallarán.

programme.title: Naruto: La Décima Pregunta: Todo O Nada
programme.desc: La parte más difícil es la pregunta número 10. Antes de que escuchen la pregunta, Ibiki explica una regla muy severa: si responden mal a la pregunta, reprobarán el primer examen y el equipo perderá el derecho de tomar otros Exámenes en el futuro.

programme.title: Naruto: Reporte Especial: ¡En Vivo Desde El Bosque De La Muerte!
programme.desc: Konohamaru, el nieto del Tercer Hokage de la Aldea de la Hoja, aparece en el Examen, junto con Moegi y Udon, para cubrir los eventos en el periódico de la Academia Ninja. Konohamaru admira a Naruto y hace entrevistas a los personajes.

programme.title: Naruto: El Examen Chunin Segunda Etapa: El Bosque De La Muerte
programme.desc: Llegan al bosque de la Muerte, a la segunda parte del Examen. Cada equipo recibirá un pergamino. El equipo debe robar a otro equipo y después llegar a la torre con ambos pergaminos. La encargada del examen, Anko les da un consejo: “¡No se dejen matar!”

programme.title: Naruto: Comer O Ser Comido: Pánico En El Bosque
programme.desc: El segundo examen comienza. Sasuke se da cuenta de que un enemigo ha tomado la apariencia de Naruto y lo sigue. Sasuke rescata a Naruto, que estaba atado. Los tres compañeros de equipo deciden crear una contraseña por si vuelven a separarse de nuevo.

programme.title: Naruto: El contraataque de Naruto: Nunca Rendirse
programme.desc: El ninja que ataca a Sasuke y Sakura es muy poderoso. Sasuke casi entrega su pergamino, pero Naruto lo detiene de un golpe. La ira de Naruto crece al luchar, y su poder aflora. Entre tanto, la examinadora Anko descubre un problema sobre los participantes.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold, cansado que Helga siempre se burle de él en la escuela, le pide consejo al Abuelo acerca de lo que debe hacer. / Arnold es el encargado del entretenimiento en el baile anual de la escuela y le pide a Dino Spumoni que cante en él.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Helga tiene su propio número de entretenimiento, hacer imitaciones bastante buenas de los demás. / Los chicos se quedan atrapados en la escuela cuando una tormenta inunda las calles.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: La clase del Señor Simmons hará la obra anual de la escuela, este año él eligió la obra Romeo y Julieta, y cuando Helga se entera que Arnold hará a Romeo, ella hará hasta lo imposible por quedarse con el papel de Julieta.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Cuando Big Bob llama a Arnold huérfano en el fin de semana de los padres, Arnold le pregunta al Abuelo qué pasó realmente con sus padres.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold pierde las invitaciones de la fiesta de cumpleaños de Eugene y nadie asiste, pero luego que Arnold le organiza una segunda fiesta y también fracasa. / Stinky decide probar suerte con la jardinería.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Helga gana una cena para cuatro personas y decide llevar a Phoebe para que ella lleve a Gerald y a su mejor amigo. / Phoebe es promovida al sexto grado, y Helga tiene problemas buscando una compañera.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Harold, Sid y Stinky le hacen una broma de muy mal gusto al Director Wartz. / Olga viene de visita otra vez, y es la nueva ayudante del Profesor Simmons.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Para pagar su deuda con el Gran Gino, Sid deberá trabajar para él. / Cuando Jamie O, el hermano de Gerald, se enamora de una chica, Gerald por fin tiene un hermano que lo trata bien.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Miriam reemplaza a Bob en su trabajo, pero comienza a distanciarse más de lo normal de Helga. / Oskar, quien nunca aprendió a leer, le pide a Arnold que le enseñe.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Mientras buscan a Appa, los niños se encuentran con Jet, pero no están seguros si deben confiar en él o no. Mientras tanto, Zuko también decide buscar a Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los chicos luchan contra Long Feng y los Dai Li para intentar demostrarle al Rey de la Tierra la gran conspiración que está teniendo lugar en su ciudad. Zuko se enferma gravemente y se enfrenta a una crisis espiritual.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Un gurú en el Templo del Aire del Este ayuda a Aang a dar el siguiente paso en su viaje hacia ser Avatar. Sokka se encuentra con su padre perdido. Azula trama un plan diabólico y Zuko y su tío abren una nueva tienda de té.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Todos comienzan una corrida contra el tiempo para detener a Azula de su siniestra conquista de Ba Sing Se. El destino de Aang pende de un hilo, al igual que el de Zuko.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Después de sufrir lesiones graves al final de la segunda temporada, Aang despierta a bordo de un barco de la Nación del Fuego. Mientras tanto, Zuko viaja de regreso a casa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Para camuflarse mejor como verdaderos ciudadanos de la Nación del Fuego, los niños roban ropas tradicionales. Aang explora una escuela de la Nación del Fuego. Zuko visita a su tío en prisión.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando el grupo llega a un pueblo pescadero que se encuentra en sufirmiento, descubren que un misterioso espíritu está ayudando a los aldeanos.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando Sokka siente que no está contribuyendo lo suficiente al grupo, busca a un misterioso maestro que le enseñe todo sobre las espadas.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
